logline: Nimbus is an open-world RPG set within a hauntingly beautiful yet dystopian post-apocalyptic universe, where a group of rebels has taken arms against a stable yet repressive regime.
themes: responsibility without being the chosen one
the ends do not justify the means
setting: The world consists of nine distinct floating sky cities, or 'clouds,' each representing a different socioeconomic district. Players begin their journey at the very bottom of this celestial hierarchy in the slums of the first cloud. As they navigate this precarious world, they must rise from obscurity, navigating complex social stratifications and dangerous environments. The player has a mysterious power where they can sense how radiated people are and how to help them are and can exert psionic control over them proportionally to how radiated they are. The player has to use this power at crucial moments.
invariants: Characters can be killed, but some only downed for a short time
